[[File:Soulreaper axe detail.png|left|150px]]
The '''Soulreaper axe''' is a two-handed [[Weapons/Categories#Axe|axe]] that requires 80 [[Attack]] and [[Strength]] to wield. It is created by combining four untradeable components, obtained as drops from [[The Leviathan]], [[The Whisperer]], [[Vardorvis]], and [[Duke Sucellus]], alongside 2,000 [[blood rune]]s and level 75 [[Magic]] (which cannot be boosted).

Despite being made from items dropped by prominent [[Zarosians]], the item itself '''does not''' grant [[god protection]] towards Zarosian NPCs in the [[God Wars Dungeon]].

==Soul stacks==
[[File:Soul Stack.png|left]]
''Soul stacks'' are generated every time a player makes an attack and has not reached five stacks, which are applied whenever the player attacks with the axe (even if they miss). Each stack is added after the damage from the player's attack is calculated, so an attack does not benefit from the 6% bonus it just generated.

Each ''Soul stack'' provides a 6% boost to a player's [[Strength]] level, up to a maximum of +30% at five stacks. This boost is additive with, and works similarly to, the Strength multipliers from prayers like [[Piety]] or [[Ultimate Strength]]. ''Soul stacks'' do not affect other weapons. Each stack will last for 50 ticks if the player is unable to attack during that time frame.

When the player can maintain five stacks for the 30% strength bonus, the soulreaper axe has the capability to deal more damage than weapons like the [[Inquisitor's mace]] or [[blade of Saeldor]], and can even out-DPS the [[Scythe of Vitur]] against 1x1 or 2x2-sized monsters. Against 3x3 or larger sized monsters, the Scythe of Vitur will typically provide a higher damage output. The boost provided from the soul stacks can be further increased with boosts such as [[super strength]] potions and strength-boosting gear.

''Soul stacks'' are maintained as long as a player is actively attacking with the Soulreaper axe equipped, with one stack decaying every {{ticks|50}} if the player is not doing so. In areas with aggressive enemies, very little input is required to keep the strength buff maximised. This makes the axe exceptional for combat encounters with little downtime, including bosses like [[Araxxor]] and [[Vardorvis]], and lower intensity combat like [[Slayer]] and the [[Nightmare Zone]].

==Special attack==
[[File:Behead.gif|thumb|250px|A player performing the soulreaper axe's special attack, ''Behead,'' with five Soul Stacks.]]
The Soulreaper axe has a [[special attack]], ''Behead'', which consumes all Soul Stacks and does not require special attack energy.

For each Soul Stack consumed, ''Behead'' increases the player's accuracy by 12% and maximum and minimum damage by 6%, meaning when using a special attack with all five stacks, the attack will have 60% increased accuracy, 30% increased max hit, and deal a minimum of at least 30% of their max hit.

Since the special attack only consumes Soul stacks, in PvP it's useful to combo ''Behead'' into special attacks from other weapons like the [[granite maul]], [[dragon claws]], or [[Voidwaker]] for high amounts of burst damage on the target.

===Mechanics===
Although the in-game description states ''Behead'' deals additional damage, this is in relation to base damage and not the boosted level from active soul stacks.

When using ''Behead'', the [[Strength]] boost from Soul stacks is consumed first and a new separate ''damage'' bonus is applied to the swing. Consequently the strength bonus is then lost, meaning ''Behead'' also costs 90% of an additional attack when a player continues combat.

Note: in rare situations, the alternate damage calculation of the special attack can result in ''Behead'' having a lower max hit than a regular auto attack.

The accuracy roll for ''Behead'' uses the attack bonus of the player's currently selected style, which is rolled against the corresponding defensive bonuses of an opponent – either slash or crush in this case.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1699335106479968443|date=6 September 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27963996|archivedate=11 May 2026|quote=[Could you look into the soul reaper axe? I submitted a bug report already. Im using it in pvp and there is 0 chance the accuary buff  is working on the spec. (...)] Looks like it's applying it on the spec, nevertheless, rolling the result against the target's slash or crush defence depending on your active style (which is unusual for a spec).}} This is in contrast to most other special attacks, which roll against the defensive bonuses of an opponent of a specific combat style regardless of the attacking combat style chosen (for example, the [[dragon dagger]]'s special attack will always roll against the opponent's slash defence, even if the attack style is set to stab).

==Changes==
{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|update = Summer Sweep-Up Gear & PvM Changes
|date = 22 July 2026
|change = 
* The soulreaper axe has received the following changes:
** Strength bonus increased from +121 to +125.
** Players will now take no damage at all from gaining soul stacks, instead of 8 per stack.
** The amount of time in which the player can be out of combat before soul stacks begin decaying has been increased from {{ticks|20}} to  {{ticks|50}}.
* The special attack, ''Behead'', has received the following changes:
** The animation for ''Behead'' has been graphically updated.
** The accuracy bonus for ''Behead'' has been increased from 6% per soul stack to 12%, for a maximum of 60% at five stacks.
** ''Behead'' has been given a minimum hit threshold, at 6% of the player's maximum hit per stack, for a maximum of 30% at five stacks.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 3 June 2026
|type= hotfix
|change = Fixed an issue in which all soul stacks were lost rather than one every 20 ticks when not attacking with the axe.
}}

==Trivia==
* The soulreaper axe was based on a suggestion by Reddit user ''moronijess'',{{CiteForum|author = moronijess|url = https://www.reddit.com/r/2007scape/comments/117fp21/sandbreaker_axe_concept_for_community_design/|title = Sandbreaker Axe Concept for Community Design|forum = Reddit|postdate = 20 February 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/27963995|archivedate=11 May 2026}} who was credited for the suggestion in an update newspost.{{CiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/desert-treasure-ii-rewards-beta?oldschool=1|title=Desert Treasure II Rewards Beta|newsdate=12 April 2023|quote='''Soulreaper Axe:''' A 2h Axe that will be created by combining the four pieces dropped by the post-quest bosses that was a community-designed weapon inspired by moronijess' design}}
* Despite the poll blog and newspost stating the axe requires full completion of [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire]] to wield, this is not the case in-game.
